responsibility: Implements default-channel SHORTREAL text I/O as a thin wrapper over ShortIO and StdChans. It simply forwards reads to the current standard input channel and formatting writes to the current standard output channel, providing the ISO convenience surface for short real I/O.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements SShortIO by delegating SHORTREAL input/output procedures to ShortIO with StdChans.StdInChan and StdChans.StdOutChan. It differs from SShortIO.def, which only defines the module's public default-channel SHORTREAL API.
